headline: Powerful 7.7 Earthquake Hits Eastern Indonesia
standfirst: A major tremor struck the Flores region, forcing thousands to evacuate coastal areas.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: A shallow 7.7-magnitude earthquake hit the Flores region of eastern Indonesia early Saturday.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: The US Geological Survey recorded the tremor, which was strong enough to trigger regional alarm.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: Authorities issued an immediate tsunami warning, causing thousands of people to flee to high ground.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: We are waiting on official updates regarding potential damage or casualties from the region.

caption:
A major 7.7-magnitude earthquake has struck the Flores region in eastern Indonesia today.

Local authorities issued a tsunami warning immediately following the tremor. Thousands of residents evacuated to higher ground in panic. We are currently monitoring reports for updates on the impact of this shallow quake.
